String is final and immutable; both stored keys and values are runtime checked before insertion. Null is permitted by CheckedMap as by its underlying Java map; this review does not invent or accept a new public null-valued DTO contract.
Script-authored Java try/catch may still catch the checked failure and continue with a valid mutation. Only escaping recognized type failures are translated in the original exploration scope.

Classifier unwraps only ScriptException and WrappedException, with a bounded 32-hop walk; cancellation and other typed control failures continue to the existing rethrowRuleControlFailure path. No global Rhino or mainJs policy was altered.

Scope/grant/deadline and LRU99 lifecycle findings from v1 remain unchanged. Every persistence access continues to use the invocation cache and native grant rather than retaining old invocation authority.
Final WebBook changes preserve original ordinary error and BookList order; only the explicit unsupported-map boundary is checked before ordinary recovery.
